title: Drummers: Ed Thigpen, Jo Jones and Cozy Cole
summary: Ed Thigpen went abroad with Humes and lives in Europe, and his father was a good drummer. Humes calls Jo Jones her alma mater, and Cozy Cole sweet and reliable.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Great drummers: who they admired and why

blocks.x: That's very interesting. That's good. Well listen, just before we leave these musicians, I just wanted to ask about a couple. I didn't realize but Ed Thigpen (father was Ben Thigpen) was with you.

S. & S. REPORTING COMPANY, INC.
WOrth 2-2915 WOrth 2-2943
I was just going to say to you. His father was a drummer too, wasn't he?
I don't remember but his father was a good drummer too.
Isn't he? I've heard him on a number of records. I was really surprised how much he wrote. Well listen, drummers like, you may never have been with them at all but good drummers like Jo Jones.
Jo, he still plays. It's an amazing thing, isn't it?
He comes out here, doesn't he? There is a lady out here.
He sees her at times I think. I know Johnny Otis told me that she lived there and he didn't know who she was. And one day he saw Jo. He said, for goodness sakes. What about poor Cozy (Cole)?
He was one of the great ones.
S. & S. REPORTING COMPANY, INC. WOrth 2-2915 WOrth 2-2943
A sweet man, wasn't he? And you could always rely on him. He always wanted to play for you. And he never tried to hog it.
